mintAuthority.summary: steakUSDC is an immutable Morpho Vault V2 ERC-4626 vault. User shares mint against USDC deposits, and interest accrual can mint fee shares; both fee rates were zero at the observed block. VaultV2Supervisor owns the vault and is owned by the observed Steakhouse 5-of-10 Safe. Base USDC issuance remains inherited from Circle.

upgradeability.controlRef: steakUSDC Morpho Vault V2 (immutable, asset-backed shares)

controls.label: steakUSDC Morpho Vault V2 (immutable, asset-backed shares)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095798, asset() was USDC and owner() was VaultV2Supervisor. The verified exact-deployment source is VaultV2, with no upgrade entrypoint; the EIP-1967 implementation, corrected admin, and beacon slots were zero. User deposit/mint calls transfer underlying assets before creating shares. accrueInterest() can also create management and performance fee shares; both configured fee rates were zero. The old MetaMorpho/deposit-only description did not cover this deployment's fee-share path.

controls.label: Steakhouse vault owner chain — 5-of-10 Safe (parameter control)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095798, VaultV2Supervisor.owner() returned this Safe. getOwners() returned the listed 10 owners, including nine replacements relative to the previous observation, and getThreshold() returned 5. getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) returned an empty list; the Safe guard storage slot was zero. Vault governance remains parameter control rather than discretionary creation of USDC.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095798, the exact deployed code was immutable Morpho Vault V2, with zero EIP-1967 implementation, corrected admin, and beacon slots. The USDC asset and VaultV2Supervisor-to-5-of-10-Safe owner chain were reconfirmed, with current owners, empty modules, and zero guard. User minting is asset-backed; interest accrual can mint fee shares. Durable USDC issuance remains inherited from Circle.
